# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 4: Act III Atlantic Hegemony & Act IV Nostos / Imperium Bicephalum (oe_elr_, Slot 74). Generated by gen_elysia_return.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Identifies the active settled Nova Elysia realm (BYZ/TRE/FEO/ROM in the Americas).
oe_elr_is_elysia_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_or_had_tag = FEO
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
			exists = capital
			OR = {
				capital.continent = continent:america
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Major Atlantic European colonial powers.
oe_elr_is_atlantic_power = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = SPA
		tag = CAS
		tag = POR
		tag = ENG
		tag = GBR
		tag = FRA
		tag = NED
		tag = HOL
	}
}

# Country scope. True when any Old World colonial power has reached the Americas or sighted Chesapeake.
oe_elr_any_old_world_power_in_america = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:SPA
			c:SPA = {
				OR = {
					any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
					has_discovered = location:chesapeake
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:CAS
			c:CAS = {
				OR = {
					any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
					has_discovered = location:chesapeake
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:POR

				OR = {
					any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
					has_discovered = location:chesapeake
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:ENG
			c:ENG = {
				OR = {
					any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
					has_discovered = location:chesapeake

		}
		AND = {

# Country scope. Iberian presence in Caribbean / Mesoamerica / Florida.
oe_elr_iberian_in_caribbean = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:SPA
			c:SPA = {
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:caribbean_region
						region = region:mesoamerica_region
						area = area:florida_area
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:CAS
			c:CAS = {
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:caribbean_region
						region = region:mesoamerica_region
						area = area:florida_area
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:POR
			c:POR = {
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:caribbean_region
						continent = continent:america
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when vanilla Great Pestilence situation or disease is active.
oe_elr_great_pestilence_active = {
	OR = {
		situation:great_pestilence = { situation_is_active = yes }
		disease_is_active = disease:great_pestilence
		country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence
	}
}

# Country scope. Path B v9.8 Religio Romana + Asclepius seated Easter egg trigger.
oe_elr_has_asclepius_seated = {
	exists = religion
	religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
		any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god }
	}
}

# Country scope. True while Reformation or European Wars of Religion are active.
oe_elr_europe_religious_war_active = {
	OR = {
		situation:war_of_religions = { situation_is_active = yes }
		situation:reformation = { situation_is_active = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Act III Atlantic Mastery milestone check.
oe_elr_atlantic_mastery_met = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:chesapeake
		owns = location:nansemond
	}
	owns = location:manhattan
	owns = location:bermuda
	any_owned_location = {
		region = region:caribbean_region
	}
	navy_size >= 15
}

# Country scope. Act IV Nostos launch threshold check.
oe_elr_nostos_thresholds_met = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:chesapeake
		owns = location:nansemond
	}
	owns = location:manhattan
	owns = location:roanoke
	any_owned_location = {
		count >= 25
		continent = continent:america
	}
	OR = {
		total_sub_unit_count:navy_heavy_ship >= 15
		navy_size >= 25
	}
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1520
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1480
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Owns an Atlantic staging hub (Azores/Gibraltar/Macaronesia) or completed fleet staging.
oe_elr_has_staging_port = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:ponta_delgada
		owns = location:angra
		owns = location:gibraltar
		owns = location:funchal
		owns = location:teguise
		has_variable = oe_elr_azores_staging_done
	}
}

# Country scope. Holds a Mediterranean or Strait foothold for Stage 2 Nostos breakthrough.
oe_elr_has_mediterranean_foothold = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:gibraltar
		owns = location:constantinople
		owns = location:rome
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				region = region:balkan_region
				region = region:italy_region
				region = region:anatolia_region
				area = area:sicily_area
				area = area:morea_area
				area = area:aegean_archipelago_area
				area = area:andalusia_area
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (root = attacker, scope:target = defender). Eligibility for oe_elr_cb_nostos_reclamation.
oe_elr_nostos_cb_valid = {
	oe_elr_is_elysia_host = yes
	has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_new_world_era_declared }
	exists = scope:target
	scope:target = {
		NOT = { this = root }
		NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
		OR = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			owns = location:rome
			owns = location:gibraltar
			owns = location:ponta_delgada
			owns = location:angra
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Imperium Bicephalum twin-capital reform is active.
oe_elr_is_bicephalum_active = {
	has_variable = oe_elr_imperium_bicephalum_unlocked
	has_reform = government_reform:oe_elr_ref_imperium_bicephalum
}
